channel.title: A.I. Systems :: CS Two Year Refactor
channel.description: Working draft for faculty review. Premise The B.S. in Artificial Intelligence shares its first two years in full with the B.S. in Computer Science — the same core, course for course. The upper division is where the two degrees diverge: A.I. adds a dedicated sequence covering AI foundations, machine learning, knowledge engineering, and an applied domain, built primarily from K-State’s existing undergraduate CIS course suite together with a small number of new courses proposed alongside this degree.
